thread:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT: routing-service error rate > 8x baseline in eu-west-1 and intermittent multi-region fallback loops. Paging oncall (@oncall-Ben). :rotating_light:

SRE-Alice: seeing a spike in 502s and latency to customers in EU. dashboards show repeated region fallback events, requests keep bouncing between eu-west-1 -> us-west-2 -> eu-west-1.

oncall-Ben: acked. I'm on it. pulling logs now.

infra-Carmen: I'm seeing model selector returning 'variant: experiment-2026-quant' for a bunch of prod routes that should be pinned to 'prod-v1'. That variant is much larger and OOMing which triggers our fallback logic.

SRE-Alice: wait — last night's routing schema rollout removed deprecated field `default_variant` and introduced `model_fallback_policy`. if parser treats missing `default_variant` as empty we might be falling back to the wrong default.

oncall-Ben: rolling log snippet:
```
2026-03-01T02:14:22Z ERROR routing: selector returned fallback='region-auto' variant='experiment-2026-quant' request_id=abc123
2026-03-01T02:14:23Z WARN  runtime: OOM, evicting kv-cache pid=4521
2026-03-01T02:14:24Z ERROR routing: unable to serve -> trigger fallback to other region
```

prod-Dan: customers A and B reported timeouts; Customer C reported inconsistent generation quality (wrong variant). impact: elevated latencies, partial degradations for ~12% of requests routed to EU, spike started after schema deployment at 02:00 UTC.

customer-ops-Eva: CS fielding tickets. 3 enterprise tenants impacted, tickets flagged as high severity. telling them we're investigating and will follow up with mitigation ETA.

SRE-Alice: immediate mitigations we should consider: 1) disable smart routing / fallback policy, 2) pin critical routes to prod-v1, 3) revert schema change, 4) reduce retry/backoff to avoid loop. Thoughts?

oncall-Ben: doing 1 & 2 now. running ad-hoc API to set route pins.

oncall-Ben: curl to pin routes (run):
```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/v1/routes/pin \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","model_variant":"prod-v1","until":"2026-03-01T06:00:00Z"}'
```

infra-Carmen: applied pin for /v1/generate on the routing plane in eu-west-1. also toggled feature flag to disable smart fallback for the group of impacted tenants. responses look stable for a few minutes. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: config-deploy 1790001201 succeeded (routing-schema-v2) by infra-Carmen.

SRE-Alice: Carmen — can you revert the parsing change in routing-config-parser? commit 5f3abd0 introduced dropping of default_variant when absent. That matches the timing.

infra-Carmen: starting revert now. git commands:
```
git revert 5f3abd0 -m 1 && make deploy routing-parser
```

oncall-Ben: also lowering retry budget to avoid bounce loops: set MAX_FALLBACKS=1 in runtime config.

SRE-Alice: good. capturing customer impact for postmortem: - 3 enterprise tenants degraded, - overall EU 95th latency increased ~600ms during window, - ~0.8% increase in error rate cluster-wide.

customer-ops-Eva: passing status to customers: "We've deployed temporary route pins and disabled smart routing for impacted tenants. We're rolling back the routing schema change that caused the fallback behavior and will keep you updated."

infra-Carmen: revert deployed to canary and rolled to eu-west-1. parser now honors legacy `default_variant` when present and uses safe fallback to 'prod-v1' if unset.

SRE-Alice: monitoring — error rate trending down. still watching for residual retries.

oncall-Ben: handing off to Carmen for follow-up/cleanup. I'll update on-call notes.

SRE-Alice: good handoff. next actions for post-incident: 1) hotfix to schema migration to fail-fast on deprecated fields, 2) add unit tests for parser edge cases, 3) add canary traffic test for routing changes, 4) document fallback defaults in config reference, 5) run a customer impact sweep to identify any missed tenants. owner: infra-Carmen. ETA 48h for patch + tests.

prod-Dan: prioritized: notify account teams for impacted tenants, prepare credits/SLR if needed.

customer-ops-Eva: collecting ticket IDs and affected org IDs now.

SRE-Alice: temporary mitigation summary for timeline: pinned prod routes at 02:18 UTC, disabled smart fallback at 02:22 UTC, revert deployed 02:40 UTC, error rate normalized by 02:48 UTC.

oncall-Ben: note for postmortem: our schema migration allowed silent behavioral change when deprecated fields were omitted. treat as P0 process gap.

infra-Carmen: creating follow-up issue: INFRA-3124 "routing-config-parser: preserve legacy default_variant behavior / explicit fail-fast on schema changes". assigning to myself. link: https://jira.redwood/INFRA-3124

SRE-Alice: recording incident owner: SRE-Alice. postmortem owner: infra-Carmen. ETA for postmortem draft: EOD tomorrow.

prod-Dan: thumbs: :white_check_mark: let's keep communications clear and offer credits to impacted customers.

customer-ops-Eva: sending status update to customers now.

deploy-bot: incident-note pinned to channel by SRE-Alice.

SRE-Alice: closing out immediate paging. Ben — thanks for triage. Carmen — please loop in release manager for a safe rollout plan for the fixed schema.

oncall-Ben: oncall->done, handing to infra-Carmen.

infra-Carmen: will follow through, adding action items to the ticket. thanks all. :pray:
